decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD sits squarely within the label's long-held compilation and reissue expertise, so the firm can read its sales and keep it in the warehouse catalog at little cost.
The illustrated release series builds on the firm's established skill in carefully produced editions, and a series format lets it apply what it learns to each new volume.
A reissued jazz LP draws directly on the firm's core reissue knowledge and suits the growing vinyl demand among collectors, so it fits the strategy of broadening genres and formats.
Multi-disc box sets are a signature competence of specialist reissue labels and carry high value for collectors, though limited pressings could eventually sell out.
The compilation CD is close to the firm's core offer and cheap to keep listed, though its weaker web presence and the declining CD market make it somewhat more likely to go out of print.
